meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are shares of mortgages in the CFPB's sample that were behind on payments, not counts of foreclosure filings or of people. A delinquent mortgage may be cured, modified or paid off. County figures exist only where the CFPB's sample holds at least 1,000 mortgages.

changes.title: Mortgage delinquency by county updated
changes.summary: The CFPB files now run through March 2026: 1.1% of U.S. mortgages were 90 or more days delinquent and 1.8% were 30 to 89 days delinquent.

changes.title: Mortgage delinquency by county first published
changes.summary: CFPB shares of mortgages 90 or more and 30 to 89 days delinquent for the nation, every state and DC and 507 counties, monthly from January 2008 to December 2025: in December 2025, 0.9% of U.S. mortgages were 90 or more days delinquent, against a high of 4.9% in January 2010 and February 2010.
